{{Quote|You're really doing this? Coming after me over a measly pack of Jawas? I'm a merc for life, but even I got limits to what jobs I'll take!|Kreegan Ramar|<ref name="Mail">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=message|I don't believe it!|Kreegan Ramar}}</ref>}}
'''Kreegan Ramar''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and [[Galactic War]]. He and his fellow mercenaries were terrorizing the [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]] [[Meerko Clan]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], which caused [[Meerko]] to use the [[Bounty Brokers Association]] to place a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on his head.

He wore [[Color/Legends|gray and red]] [[Mandalorian Seeker armor]].

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|I'll definitely have to pay that Meerko and his clan a special visit after I'm done with you.|Kreegan Ramar leaving his message to the individual who had been causing him trouble|<ref name="Mail" />}}
Kreegan Ramar was a tall male muscular [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]].

Unlike his fellow Mandalorians, Kreegan showed many dishonorable traits that was unfitting of an Mandalorian. He enjoyed terrorizing the Meerko Clan, raiding and stealing much of their belongings, he gave Mandalorians a bad name to their reputation though he claimed be a mercenary for life and that he had limits to jobs he'll take. Despite his dishonorable traits and actions, he showed no fear of death as any other Mandalorian, believing he would go out fighting.

==Behind the scenes==
Kreegan Ramar first appeared in game update 2.3 of the MMORPG ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2013]]. He is only accessible through the Bounty Contract Week event.
